en-US.title: Rowflare
en-US.subtitle: Offline Block Puzzle
en-US.description:
Place colorful shapes on an 8×8 board, clear complete rows and columns, and build consecutive-clear combos.

Rowflare is a focused, offline-first puzzle with drag controls and a tap-to-place alternative. Board-aware trays reduce unfair dead deals, while limited Shuffle, Break, and Hint helpers keep difficult runs moving.

Features:
• Fast offline sessions with no account
• Resume an active run after closing the app
• Combo scoring, Cross Blasts, haptics, and synthesized audio
• Reduced-motion and screen-reader-aware controls
• Optional rewarded helpers where available; no forced ads

Plan your space, protect your next move, and chase a brighter chain.
en-US.releaseNotes: Rowflare 1.0 introduces the complete offline puzzle loop, local run restore, accessible tap placement, combo scoring, and polished feedback.

review.notes: No account is required. The game works offline. Rewarded ads are currently Android-only and appear only after a helper reaches zero; no ad is forced. Reviewers can use the complete iOS game without an ad.
